g.text: d Fully genuine recordings: false-alarm duration

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 19px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #414653

g.text: Fixed rule probes | Structural edits have competing effects

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #414653

g.text: Prespecified retrospective probes on saved predictions; these are not development-selected or independently validated improvements

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #414653

g.text: Merge fills inter-prediction gaps no longer than the stated duration. Delete removes predicted intervals no longer than that duration.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #414653

g.text: The combined rule merges first, then deletes. Rule outcomes use evaluation labels only for retrospective measurement; no learned corrector has been evaluated.
